modeling_decisions: Concept inspected: retain four different-size separated towers and broad low corridors. Reduce concept numerous masonry-like rectangular blocks to broad natural dissolution facets, rounded asymmetric crowns and occasional subdued bedding steps. No central high ridge connecting towers. Towers emerge from low plain through continuous foot geometry, not stacked exposed coplanar slabs. Generic muted limestone, no huge leafy crowns, identical straight cylinders or stone-forest needles.
repair_note: r002 top exposes small gaps at quadrant corners because radial sampling omitted exact rectangle corners. Correct boundary topology by explicit corner angles, not rendering concealment. Also reduce overly uniform ring-like bedding to subtle uneven wall offsets; keep steep lower walls and rounded crowns, not tiered cones.
